title: Prove sharp mixed-grid cleanup for a physical P104 collector
body:
PR2665 leaves mixed precision open after showing that same-grid rounding prevents strict-zero erasure in the first physical P104 collector. This proves an all-input local repair for its exact source head `f9e96e979b7630b7a70705c9774d00fc07014110`: when all five dirty sources and the dirty query enter on the complex h-grid, retaining the completed outbound collector and exact query on h/16, then returning on h, restores the private collector exactly. Four additional outbound fractional bits are necessary for this completed-output nearest-even contract.

The proof binds the actual physical frames and ±1 instructions at events 2025–2039, all 1,024 columns of both native recipes, and all 512 inverse columns. It explicitly uses the return input's membership in the actual U image of the h-grid sum. Arbitrary fine-grid inverse entrances and coarse query endpoints are excluded by retained failure controls. The separate storage bill is 4,096 additional fractional bits for the private buffer plus 4,096 for the exact query output; completed-value magnitude bounds are 80B and 81B. The unchanged local word has two rank-seven children, eleven unit ADDs, one zero initialization and one exact erasure.

Only `research/p104-mixed-grid-collector/` is added. Arham Tahir's PR2665 negative example, checker and exact source inputs are retained and credited, with the full predecessor receipt replayed unchanged. The new contribution is the all-input changed-grid contract, sharpness and explicit precision bill, with an independently written matrix implementation.

Validation: registered CPython 3.12.14 replay, Git-free read-only optimized CPython 3.14.5 integrity suite, all-five-source dense fixtures, four insufficient guards, twelve scaled relative-error witnesses, wrong-cleanup/inverse controls, typed receipt/duplicate-key/source corruption and CLI/output refusal. All 13 committed files were checked against the tested Git bytes. Separate OpenAI Codex agents reviewed the proof and source binding; one independently ran the optimized 3.12 replay. No independent human, proof-assistant or hosted-CI success is claimed.

Scientific base main `b97accd36a3e8ee0a11d008671f0b3950d27dca8`, priority 5; final canonical refresh `d91f73786c851f85c239b508b5895576901304d0` leaves guidance, selected record and replay runner unchanged. Open-PR snapshot 18:27 UTC and Discussion snapshot 15:22 UTC are bounded coverage; current PR2665 head/comments and newer P104 submissions 2725/2729 were checked separately. [Canonical claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2665#issuecomment-6199396889).

This is a completed-operation local precision contract. Internally rounded native execution, rounded-prefix grid availability, fine-query consumer admission, ownership/hosting, tape cost, the remaining 102 corrections and all-size supplier admission remain open. It does not change the selected frontier or kappa. The README states concrete next questions and the family decision to stop at this local result. Prepared for ywz65 with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0.
